Entry Jade Sea The Jade Sea connects Yidi, Qarth, Asshai and beyond, and is a huge body of water where trade and mythology flow together. Shipowners judge it by its winds and harbors, maesters imagine it from the edges of maps; to those on shore, the sea is both a path to wealth and a way to swallow up news. Altars, relics, and prophecies can unite people and give a political claim the appearance of irrefutability.

Some people use it as a talisman, while others use it as the name of fear; the same prayer may make people draw their swords or put them down.
